{{Top|leg}}
'''Arin''' lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and was friends with [[Pthillip]]. Together they befriended [[Lora Nadad]], a member of "[[The Lost (children)|The Lost]]," street orphans in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Together, they took Nadad to the [[Almas Academy]] where she was later trained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].
